settings.question: How long does delivery take?
settings.answer: Standard shipping to the US is free on every order and arrives in 5–8 business days. Need it sooner? Express is 2–4 business days at checkout. You'll get a tracking link the moment it ships.

settings.question: Will the grinder scare my dog?
settings.answer: It runs under 50 dB — roughly the volume of a fridge. Most dogs settle within two sessions. Start with the motor on but away from the paw, reward, then work up to a single nail.

settings.question: What's your returns policy?
settings.answer: 30 days from delivery, used or unused. Email us and we'll send a prepaid label — refunds land within five business days of the parcel reaching us.

settings.question: How do I pick the right size?
settings.answer: Every apparel listing has a measurement chart based on back length, not weight. Measure from collar to tail base — when between sizes, size up.
